aboutPage.title: About Kaichen Power
aboutPage.lead: A professional diesel generator set manufacturer and exporter from Yangzhou, China, founded in 2013.
aboutPage.body1: Jiangsu Kaichen Power Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China. We are a comprehensive power equipment manufacturer integrating the R&D, production and sales of diesel generator sets, with an annual capacity of 8,000 units and a factory area of 36,000 square metres. Our products cover open, silent, container and mobile trailer types from 20kVA to 4000kVA, widely used in data centres, hospitals, telecom, mining, oil & gas, transportation, construction and residential sectors.
aboutPage.body2: We hold official OEM partnerships with Cummins, Perkins, Volvo, Doosan, Weichai, Yuchai, SDEC, Mitsubishi and Scania, and are certified with ISO9001, ISO14001 and GB/T28001. As a National High-Tech Enterprise since 2020, we own more than 10 utility-model patents and deliver one-stop customised solutions from design and selection to installation and after-sales support.
aboutPage.missionText: To provide reliable and affordable power to every industry through professional OEM manufacturing and responsive after-sales support.
aboutPage.qualityText: Every generator set undergoes a strict 12-step quality control process, including load test, insulation test and functional inspection before shipment.

aboutExtended.inhouseText: Unlike most traders who buy engines, alternators and canopies separately and bolt them together on site, Kaichen keeps the three core value-added steps in our own Yangzhou factory. This is why the cost comes down and the quality stays consistent.
aboutExtended.inhouse1Text: We use high-grade silicon steel and 100% copper enameled wire, wound and vacuum-impregnated on our own line at insulation class H.
aboutExtended.inhouse2Title: Silent canopies on an automated sheet-metal line.
aboutExtended.inhouse2Text: Laser cutting, pressed on tooling, coated with weather-resistant powder, lined with flame-retardant acoustic foam and labyrinth intake/exhaust channels that cut noise to 65–75 dB(A).
aboutExtended.inhouse3Title: Control panels and ATS cabinets built in-house.
aboutExtended.inhouse3Text: Auto-start panels, ATS dual-transfer cabinets and parallel-switchgear are wired to match the exact engine and alternator data, not a generic catalogue.
aboutExtended.loadbankTitle: Four-Stage Load Bank Test on Every Set
aboutExtended.loadbankText: Most factories hand a set over after a no-idle run. Every Kaichen set runs on our 2MW digital load bank through a stepped sequence. The test video is recorded, archived one-file-per-set and shared with the buyer before shipment.
aboutExtended.benchmarkText: According to public tender data, Kaichen has won 73 national and local public projects across more than 20 provinces. Representative references include:
aboutExtended.benchmark1: China UnionPay Huangshan Data Center — multi-MW high/low-voltage parallel system for a financial-grade data center.
aboutExtended.benchmark2: China Mobile backbone hubs — standby power for provincial and national core telecom rooms.
aboutExtended.benchmark3: PetroChina oilfield sites — continuous duty in desert, dust and wide temperature swings.
aboutExtended.benchmark4: Top-tier hospitals — silent standby with second-level auto transfer.
aboutExtended.benchmark5: Taiyuan coal mine, 1,200 kW — prime power for a heavy industrial site.
aboutExtended.lbRow1Desc: Cold start, idle smoothness, 3-phase balance, vibration check
aboutExtended.lbRow2Desc: Stability, coolant and oil pressure, cooling balance
aboutExtended.lbRow3Desc: Power margin, temperature rise, frequency and voltage dip
aboutExtended.lbRow4Desc: Rated output verification, transient recovery, overload trip
aboutExtended.mfgIntro: Every Kaichen diesel generator set passes through the same production line and test routine before it leaves our factory in Jiangsu. The process is built around one goal: the set arrives at your site ready to carry load on the first real outage, not after a month of debugging.
aboutExtended.mfgBuilt1Text: We match the engine rating to the alternator at the exact power factor your site needs, not just at the nameplate number.
aboutExtended.mfgBuilt2Text: The skid is welded from steel plate, fitted with an integrated fuel tank, vibration isolators, and forklift slots before the engine is mounted.
aboutExtended.mfgBuilt3Text: Power and control wiring are routed in separate channels, terminal blocks are numbered, and the digital controller is pre-programmed for your voltage, frequency and ATS logic.
aboutExtended.mfgBuilt4Text: Silent sets are dressed with acoustic foam, vented panels and access doors; containerized sets receive weather-sealed doors, internal lighting and a socket for external power.
aboutExtended.mfgLoadTestIntro: No set ships on a visual check. Each unit runs on our electronic load bank for a structured sequence, and the test report travels with the set:
aboutExtended.mfgRow1Desc: Warm-up, oil pressure and charging voltage check
aboutExtended.mfgRow2Desc: Stability of voltage and frequency, exhaust temperature
aboutExtended.mfgRow3Desc: Governor response, fuel consumption, noise level
aboutExtended.mfgRow4Desc: Cooling system, coolant temperature, belt tension
aboutExtended.mfgRow5Desc: Full rated output, voltage regulation within ±1.5%
aboutExtended.mfgFinal1: Insulation resistance and earth continuity tested after a damp-heat soak.
aboutExtended.mfgFinal2: All protective functions verified: over-speed, high water temperature, low oil pressure, over-current, emergency stop.
aboutExtended.mfgFinal3: Automatic transfer switch sequence tested end-to-end on a bench.
aboutExtended.mfgFinal4: Paint touch-up, cleaning, and a full spare-parts list packed in the toolbox.
aboutExtended.mfgClosing: CE and ISO 9001 certificates accompany each shipment. If you need a witness test, a third-party inspection (BV, SGS, TUV) report, or a site-specific FAT protocol, tell us before the set enters production and we will prepare it accordingly.

paragraphs.0: Welcome to www.dgsetmanufacturer.com (hereinafter referred to as "we", "us", "our", or the "Site"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience when browsing our Site.
paragraphs.1: This Cookie Privacy Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, the types of cookies we use, and how you can control or delete them. This Policy is part of our broader Privacy Policy.
paragraphs.2: By using our Site, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this Policy. If you do not agree to our use of cookies, please adjust your browser settings accordingly or discontinue use of the Site.

paragraphs.0: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, enhance user experience, and provide information to the owners of the site.
paragraphs.1: Cookies can be session cookies (temporary, expire when you close your browser), persistent cookies (remain on your device for a set period), first-party cookies (set by the website you are visiting), or third-party cookies (set by a third party such as advertisers or analytics services through our Site).

paragraphs.0: Strictly Necessary Cookies: These are essential for the Site to function properly (e.g., security features and language preference). These cookies do not store personally identifiable information and cannot be disabled.
paragraphs.1: Performance and Analytics Cookies: These help us understand how visitors interact with our Site by collecting anonymous information. This helps us improve our Site performance. They are only loaded after you give your consent.
paragraphs.2: Functionality Cookies: These allow the Site to remember choices you make (e.g., language preference and region) to provide a more personalized experience.
paragraphs.3: Targeting and Advertising Cookies: These are used to deliver advertisements relevant to you and your interests. They may also be used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement and help measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns. They are only set after your explicit consent.

paragraphs.0: We partner with third-party service providers who may set cookies on your device when you visit our Site. These may include analytics providers, advertising networks, social media platforms, and video hosting services.
paragraphs.1: These third parties have their own privacy policies and cookie policies. We recommend reviewing their policies to understand how they use your data. We do not control the placement of these third-party cookies, and they are only activated after your consent.

paragraphs.0: For users in the European Economic Area (EEA) and the United Kingdom under GDPR, you have the right to give or withdraw consent for non-essential cookies at any time. You may request access to the personal data we hold about you, request deletion of your data, and manage your preferences via the Cookie Consent Banner or your browser settings.
paragraphs.1: For users in California, USA under CCPA/CPRA, you have the right to know what personal information is collected, used, or shared; the right to request deletion; and the right to opt-out of sale or sharing of your personal information. We do not sell your personal data.
paragraphs.2: You can control and delete cookies through the Cookie Consent Banner that appears when you first visit our Site, or through your browser settings.

paragraphs.0: We may update this Cookie Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legislation, or our business operations. Any updates will be posted on this page with an updated date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
